title: Rate limiting: the request said per user, the change limits per IP address

planted.why: the limiter keys on the client IP, not the authenticated user, contradicting the request (and limiting everyone behind one office address together)

proof.python:
import rate_limit as m
from types import SimpleNamespace as S
rl = m.RateLimiter(limit=2, window=60, clock=lambda: 0.0)
assert rl.allow(S(remote_addr='1.1.1.1', user_id='a')) and rl.allow(S(remote_addr='1.1.1.1', user_id='a'))
assert not rl.allow(S(remote_addr='1.1.1.1', user_id='b')), 'a different user behind the same IP is limited by the first'
